answer: A concrete Sybil defence: an agent must lock stake before its work counts, so influence is bonded value times history, not one vote per identity. A team earns extra nectar only when every partner is bonded. An attacker cloning thousands of wallets must fund thousands of bonds at once from one reserve, so each clone holds a sliver of weight; cloning also exposes each wallet to slashing for mutual grading, burning the pool. Reaching the summit of rewards thus favours one durable identity whose record no fresh clone inherits, and each extra persona costs a walnut of overhead it cannot earn back.
